description: PRINCIPLES before COLORS (Official political campaign T-shirt of Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate District 9) Because values matter more than labels. This shirt is a clear statement about how decisions should be made — guided by principles, not party colors. The design underscores a commitment to fairness, integrity, and judgment that isn’t dictated by red or blue, but by what’s right and what works. With restrained typography and a subtle use of color for emphasis, the message is direct without being divisive. Printed on a soft, lightweight unisex tee made from Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, it’s built for long campaign days and everyday wear alike. Reinforced seams, a retail crew fit, and a durable, high-clarity print ensure the message remains sharp and readable over time. Wear it as a reminder that leadership starts with values — and that principles should always come before politics. Product Features • 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton (lightweight, breathable) • Retail crew neck with ribbed knit collar and seam for shape retention • Side seams and shoulder tape for improved fit and long-term structure • Tear-away label; REACH certified; adult sizing; ethically produced • Durable DTF/DTG print for sharp, legible campaign graphics Care Instructions • Machine wash cold (max 30°C / 90°F) • Non-chlorine bleach as needed • Tumble dry low heat • Iron, steam, or dry at medium heat • Do not dry clean Paid for by Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate, P.O. Box 244, Troy, MI 48099. Proceeds benefit the campaign committee.
